claims: Sony is increasing PlayStation 5 prices globally starting April 2, 2026.
The price increase marks the second hike in less than a year.
New US price for the standard PS5 is $649.99.
New US price for the PS5 Digital Edition is $599.99.
PS5 Digital Edition price increase is +$100.
New PS5 Console Pricing is effective April 2, 2026.
PS5 (Standard with Disc Drive) new price is $649.99.
PS5 Digital Edition new price is $599.99.
PlayStation Portal Remote Player new price is $249.99.
Sony cited "continued pressures in the global economic landscape" for the price hikes.
Prior to this increase, the standard console was roughly $550.
Prior to this increase, the Digital Edition was $500.
Prior to this hike, the Pro was priced at $750 in some regions.
Price increases affect markets in Europe and Japan.
